description_en: Lists the historical versions of an application
name: ListAppVersions

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: The call is successful.

3xx: The call is redirected.

4xx: A request error occurred.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

BuildPackageUrl.description_en:
The download URL of the code package. If you uploaded the package using SAE, note the following:

This URL is not a direct download link. You must call the GetPackageVersionAccessableUrl operation to obtain a downloadable URL that is valid for 10 minutes.

SAE stores the package for a maximum of 90 days. After this period, the URL is not returned and the package cannot be downloaded
BuildPackageUrl.description_zh:
代码包下载地址，如果您的包是通过SAE上传的需要注意以下两点：

该地址不能直接下载，需要您通过GetPackageVersionAccessableUrl接口来获取可下载的地址（有效期10分钟）。
该包SAE侧最长时间会保留90天，超过90天后不会返回给地址也不提供下载

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the version was created

Type.description_en:
The application type. Valid values:

image: The application is deployed using an image.

url: The application is deployed using a code package
Type.description_zh:
应用类型。取值说明如下：

image：表示此应用是通过镜像的方式部署的。
url：表示此应用是通过代码包的方式部署的

WarUrl.description_en: The URL of the WAR package

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

This parameter is not returned if the request is successful.

This parameter is returned if the request fails. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the historical versions of the application were successfully queried. Valid values:

true: The query was successful.

false: The query failed
Success.description_zh:
查看应用的历史版本是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：查看历史版本成功。
false：查看历史版本失败
